payload.body:
Closing as **superseded**.

This PR rewrites the EventEmitter surface across 11 source files using an `event_value` / `normalize_event_name` / `event_names.rs` approach. Since it was opened, `main` shipped a different, more complete EventEmitter refactor — `event_bits` FFI signatures, a raw-once-wrapper (`create_once_raw_wrapper` / `event_emitter_once_wrapper`), `domain_handle` support, and the `warnings.rs` split (`maybe_emit_max_listeners_warning`).

Every one of this PR's hunks conflicts with that newer design, and the equivalent behavior (listener-state alignment, max-listeners warnings, raw listeners, domain init) is already present on `main`. Re-merging the old approach would regress the newer implementation.

If any of the four test fixtures here (`raw-listeners-once-wrapper`, `stream-listener-count-filter`, `warning-emitted`, `legacy-init-using-domains`) cover cases main's implementation misses, please re-file them as a small test-only PR against current `main`.

✅ **Verified for real now** (rebuild finished, `BUILD_EXIT=0`, fresh binary). Reran the four cases against the newly built compiler — these are actual outputs:

| case | args | path | output | expected |
|------|------|------|--------|----------|
| r3   | 3  | fast path        | `123` | 123 ✓ |
| r16  | 16 | fast path (bound) | `136` | 136 ✓ |
| r18  | 18 | **array path**    | `153` | 153 ✓ |
| r20  | 20 | array path        | `190` | 190 ✓ |

The 18/20-arg recursive self-calls (which fail on `origin/main` with `Call callee shape not supported (LocalGet) with N args`) now compile and return the correct sums — confirming no args are dropped. Marking ready for review.
